# Instagram Unfollowers PRO

> Safe, local Instagram community management tool. Runs in the browser — no password required.

## Official links

- Website: https://edvincodes.github.io/InstagramUnfollowers/
- GitHub: https://github.com/EdvinCodes/InstagramUnfollowers
- Latest release: https://github.com/EdvinCodes/InstagramUnfollowers/releases/latest
- Privacy: https://edvincodes.github.io/InstagramUnfollowers/privacy.html

## What it does

Instagram Unfollowers PRO helps users see who does not follow them back, detect ghost/bot accounts with a 0-100 Ghost Score, export PDF health reports, whitelist protected accounts, and optionally use a Growth Engine (beta) to follow engaged commenters in a niche with anti-ban delays.

All processing is local in the user's browser. No Instagram password is collected.

## How to run

1. **Browser extension (recommended):** Download dist.zip from GitHub Releases, load unpacked in chrome://extensions, open instagram.com.
2. **Console script:** Copy loader.js from the website, paste in browser DevTools Console on instagram.com.
3. **Mobile bookmarklet:** Save the loader as a bookmark URL, open instagram.com, tap the bookmark.

## Key differentiators vs basic unfollowers scripts

- Ghost Score 0-100 analytics
- 16-language UI
- Real-time unfollower monitoring (extension)
- PDF/CSV exports
- Multi-account isolation
- Growth Engine (beta, PRO tier — free during v8.4 beta)

## Version

Current: 8.4.0-beta
